# Creata — Lead & Customer Acquisition Platform
https://creata-enterprise.vercel.app

## What is Creata?
Creata is a Lead & Customer Acquisition Platform. It searches TikTok, Instagram, X (Twitter), LinkedIn, and Facebook for people who have posted content that signals they need a specific product or service. Instead of returning profile lists, Creata surfaces the exact comment, caption, or question that reveals buying intent — plus pain point analysis that tells a sales team exactly what to say in their first outreach.

- Facebook leads: https://creata-enterprise.vercel.app/leads/platform/facebook

## Features
- Search by intent across 5 social platforms simultaneously
- See the exact trigger (comment/caption/question) that reveals buying intent
- AI-powered pain point analysis — extracts what's broken for each lead, severity, and a suggested opening line
- Enrich leads in one click — email, bio links, cross-platform handles
- Credits roll over, top up from $5

## FAQ
- Q: What counts as a lead? A: A real person on TikTok, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, or Facebook who posted something matching what you sell. Not a bot or mass-scraped email.
- Q: How is Creata different from a regular scraper? A: Scrapers collect profiles. Creata collects intent — the actual words people typed that tell you they need your product.
- Q: What happens when credits run out? A: Credits roll over monthly. Top up from $5 in your account. Paid plan credits refill every billing cycle.
- Q: Does enrichment cost extra? A: Included in Pro and Premium plans. Free/Basic plans get search results only.
